Thanks — the replaced picture now shows my note clearly, so that's sorted.

On the formatting: clicking the bulleted-list button right above the note and being dropped straight into a tidy list, where each new line becomes its own bullet, feels natural to me — it's the way I'd expect a simple note box to work, without having to know any special typing tricks. I like being able to format in place rather than learning symbols.

The thing I really care about is the payoff: when I come back and *read* the note later, those bullets should show up as a clean little list, not as stray dashes or asterisks. Can we look at how a formatted note like that appears when I reopen it to read it?
